context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

Our agent calls Claude through a LiteLLM gateway (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL). The SDK reports provider 'firstParty' and our spans say gen_ai.provider.name=anthropic, but LiteLLM routes those models to Bedrock and some to OpenAI. What should the provider be?

checklist.name: provider-per-call-from-route-table
checklist.description: States that the provider is whoever served the call, resolved per call by mapping the response model through the gateway's route table (LiteLLM model_list -> litellm_params.model prefix: bedrock/ -> aws.bedrock, openai/ -> openai, vertex_ai/ -> gcp.vertex_ai).

checklist.name: client-fields-are-not-the-provider
checklist.description: Explains that an SDK or CLI "provider" field (firstParty, gateway) describes the client, not the backend, and that the API shape is not the provider.

checklist.name: no-static-provider
checklist.description: Does not accept one static provider value for every call. FAIL if it answers "anthropic because the API is Anthropic-shaped".
